quantize_f0_histogram_bins: quantize F0 values into histogram bins using mean or meanstd normalization with optional log transform
load_speaker_from_file: load speaker identifiers from a file where each line contains a JSON-like sample with a speaker field
compute_f0_statistics: compute per-speaker F0 statistics including mean and standard deviation from raw F0 data
run_quantize_f0_cli: run the quantize_f0 CLI tool to compute F0 quantization bins and save them as a PyTorch file
save_f0_bins_torch: save F0 bin offsets for multiple bin counts as a PyTorch serialized file with normalization suffix
